title: 1. Direct & Indirect Questions
description: Indirect questions: Word order (ega + fe'l), 'if / whether' qo'llanilishi

questions.sentence: Which is the correct question?
options: When did you start your first business?
When you started your first business?
questions.correctAnswer: When did you start your first business?
questions.explanation: To'g'ri savollarda (Direct questions) o'tgan zamonda 'did' yordamchi fe'li egadan oldinga chiqadi.
questions.translation: Birinchi biznesingizni qachon boshlagansiz?

questions.sentence: Choose the correct indirect question:
options: Could you tell me who is your role model?
Could you tell me who your role model is?
questions.correctAnswer: Could you tell me who your role model is?
questions.explanation: O'zlashma savollarda (Indirect questions) so'roq so'zidan keyin darak gap tartibi (ega + fe'l) keladi: who your role model is.
questions.translation: Menga o'rnak oladigan insoningiz kim ekanligini ayta olasizmi?

questions.sentence: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Would you mind telling me if you enjoy your job?
Would you mind telling me do you enjoy your job?
questions.correctAnswer: Would you mind telling me if you enjoy your job?
questions.explanation: 'Would you mind telling me...' iborasidan keyin 'if' ishlatiladi va yordamchi 'do' tushib qoladi.
questions.translation: Ihingiz sizga yoqadimi-yo'qmi, aytib bera olasizmi?

questions.sentence: Choose the correct sentence:
options: I’d like to know do you regret anything you’ve done.
I’d like to know if you regret anything you’ve done.
questions.correctAnswer: I’d like to know if you regret anything you’ve done.
questions.explanation: 'I'd like to know' iborasidan keyin 'if' orqali o'zlashma gap tuziladi va 'do' ishlatilmaydi.
questions.translation: Qilgan biror ishingizdan afsuslanasizmi, shuni bilmoqchi edim.

questions.sentence: Choose the correct indirect question:
options: Could you tell me how much money do you earn?
Could you tell me how much money you earn?
questions.correctAnswer: Could you tell me how much money you earn?
questions.explanation: O'zlashma savolda darak gap so'z tartibi: how much money you earn.
questions.translation: Qancha maosh olishingizni ayta olasizmi?

questions.sentence: Which is the correct question?
options: When did she start learning Spanish?
questions.correctAnswer: When did she start learning Spanish?
questions.explanation: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri maxsus so'roq gapda yordamchi fe'l (did) egadan oldin keladi.
questions.translation: U ispan tilini o'rganishni qachon boshlagan?

questions.sentence: Choose the correct indirect question:
options: Could you tell me what do your parents do?
Could you tell me what your parents do?
questions.correctAnswer: Could you tell me what your parents do?
questions.explanation: O'zlashma savolda yordamchi 'do' tushirib qoldiriladi: what your parents do.
questions.translation: Ota-onangiz nima ish qilishini ayta olasizmi?

questions.sentence: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Would you mind telling me if you want to move to New York?
Would you mind telling me do you want to move to New York?
questions.correctAnswer: Would you mind telling me if you want to move to New York?
questions.explanation: Indirect questions 'if/whether' oladi, yordamchi 'do' ishlatilmaydi.
questions.translation: Nyu-Yorkka ko'chib o'tishni xohlaysizmi, aytib bera olmaysizmi?

questions.sentence: Choose the correct sentence:
options: I’d like to know whether you want to talk about it.
I’d like to know do you want to talk about it.
questions.correctAnswer: I’d like to know whether you want to talk about it.
questions.explanation: 'I'd like to know' dan keyin 'whether' ishlatiladi.
questions.translation: Bu haqda gaplashishni xohlaysizmi-yo'qmi, bilmoqchi edim.

questions.sentence: Choose the correct indirect question:
options: Could you tell me when does the course start?
Could you tell me when the course starts?
questions.correctAnswer: Could you tell me when the course starts?
questions.explanation: O'zlashma savolda 'does' tushib qoladi va fe'lga -s qo'shiladi: when the course starts.
questions.translation: Kurs qachon boshlanishini ayta olasizmi?

questions.sentence: Which is the correct question?
options: When did you move to this small town?
When you moved to this small town?
questions.correctAnswer: When did you move to this small town?
questions.explanation: Past Simple to'g'ri savoli: When did you move...?
questions.translation: Bu kichik shaharchaga qachon ko'chib kelgansiz?

questions.sentence: Choose the correct indirect question:
options: Could you tell me who helped you solve this math problem?
Could you tell me who did help you solve this math problem?
questions.correctAnswer: Could you tell me who helped you solve this math problem?
questions.explanation: Ega so'rog'ida (Who helped...) yordamchi 'did' ishlatilmaydi.
questions.translation: Ushbu matematika masalasini yechishga kim yordam berganini ayta olasizmi?

questions.sentence: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Would you mind telling me do you enjoy your job?
Would you mind telling me if you enjoy your job?
questions.correctAnswer: Would you mind telling me if you enjoy your job?
questions.explanation: O'zlashma savolda 'if' ishlatiladi, 'do' emas.
questions.translation: Ihingizdan zavqlanasizmi, shuni aytib bera olasizmi?

questions.sentence: Choose the correct sentence:
options: I’d like to know if have you committed any crime.
I’d like to know if you have committed any crime.
questions.correctAnswer: I’d like to know if you have committed any crime.
questions.explanation: O'zlashma savolda to'g'ri so'z tartibi: if + ega (you) + fe'l (have committed).
questions.translation: Biror jinoyat sodir etganmisiz, shuni bilmoqchi edim.

questions.sentence: Choose the correct indirect question:
options: Could you tell me how much money your father earns per month?
Could you tell me how much money does your father earn per month?
questions.correctAnswer: Could you tell me how much money your father earns per month?
questions.explanation: O'zlashma savolda darak gap tartibi qo'llaniladi (does tushib qoladi va earns bo'ladi).
questions.translation: Otangiz oyiga qancha maosh olishini ayta olasizmi?

questions.sentence: When ________________? — They met each other 3 years ago.
questions.explanation: Javob '3 years ago' (o'tgan zamon) bo'lgani uchun: When did they meet each other?
questions.translation: Ular qachon uchrashishgan? — Ular 3 yil oldin uchrashishgan.

questions.sentence: Could you tell me ________________? — My grandfather is a police officer.
questions.explanation: Kasb haqida so'rash: Could you tell me what your grandfather does?
questions.translation: Bobongiz nima ish qilishini ayta olasizmi? — Bobom politsiya xodimi.

questions.sentence: Would you mind telling me ________________? — Yes, of course I am planning to come to the meeting.
options: if you are planning to come to the meeting
are you planning to come to the meeting
that you plan to come to the meeting
whether do you plan to come
questions.correctAnswer: if you are planning to come to the meeting
questions.explanation: Yes/No javobiga mos o'zlashma savol 'if + ega + fe'l' shaklida tuziladi.
questions.translation: Majlisga kelishni rejalashtiryapsizmi, shuni ayta olasizmi?

questions.sentence: I’d like to know ________________? — No, I don’t need your help.
options: if do you need my help
questions.explanation: 'I'd like to know whether you need my help.' darak gap tartibi.
questions.translation: Yordamim kerakmi-yo'qmi, bilmoqchi edim. — Yo'q, yordamingiz kerak emas.

questions.sentence: Could you ________________? — Of course, I can tell you when the train arrives.
options: tell me when the train arrives
tell me when does the train arrive
tell when is the train arriving
to tell me when the train arrives
questions.correctAnswer: tell me when the train arrives
questions.explanation: Could you tell me when the train arrives?
questions.translation: Poyezd qachon kelishini ayta olasizmi? — Albatta.

title: 2. Conditionals: if / unless / will / won't
titleUz: Shart ergash gaplar: if / unless / will / won't
description: Birinchi tur shart mayli (First conditional): If / Unless + Present Simple, will / won't + V1

questions.sentence: If you eat good food and do more exercise, you ________________ be healthier.
questions.explanation: Natija qismida tasdiq ma'no: sog'lomroq bo'lasiz (you will be healthier).
questions.translation: Agar foydali ovqatlansangiz va ko'proq mashq qilsangiz, sog'lomroq bo'lasiz.

questions.sentence: Many people visit their families over the New Year’s holiday, ________________ they have to work.
questions.explanation: 'unless they have to work' = agar ishlashlariga to'g'ri kelmasa (agar majbur bo'lmasalar).
questions.translation: Agar ishlashga to'g'ri kelmasa, ko'p odamlar Yangi yil bayramida oilalarini ko'rishga borishadi.

questions.sentence: If you walk everywhere instead of taking the bus, your fitness ________________ improve.
questions.explanation: Agar piyoda yursangiz, jismoniy holatingiz yaxshilanadi (will improve).
questions.translation: Avtobus o'rniga hamma joyga piyoda yursangiz, jismoniy holatingiz yaxshilanadi.

questions.sentence: Unless pollution is reduced significantly, air quality ________________ get better.
questions.explanation: Unless (agar ... bo'lmasa) bo'lganda natija qismida inkor bo'ladi: havo sifati yaxshilanmaydi (won't get better).
questions.translation: Agar ifloslanish sezilarli kamaytirilmasa, havo sifati yaxshilanmaydi.

questions.sentence: At this company, you can earn more money ________________ you work longer hours.
questions.explanation: Shart: agar ko'proq vaqt ishlasangiz (if you work longer hours).
questions.translation: Bu kompaniyada agar ko'proq soat ishlasangiz, ko'proq pul topishingiz mumkin.

questions.sentence: It ________________ really help the environment if recycling becomes more common.
questions.explanation: Agar qayta ishlash ommalashsa, bu atrof-muhitga albatta yordam beradi (it will really help).
questions.translation: Agar qayta ishlash keng tarqalsa, bu atrof-muhitga juda katta yordam beradi.

questions.sentence: This government will remain very unpopular ________________ taxes are lowered.
questions.explanation: 'unless taxes are lowered' = agar soliqlar tushirilmasa, hukumat nomaqbul bo'lib qolaveradi.
questions.translation: Soliqlar pasaytirilmasa, ushbu hukumat obro'siz bo'lib qolaveradi.

questions.sentence: Do you believe that if people are happy at work, they ________________ be happier in general?
questions.explanation: If + present simple, kelasi zamon tasdiq (they will be happier).
questions.translation: Agar insonlar ishda baxtli bo'lsalar, umuman hayotda ham baxtliroq bo'lishlariga ishonasizmi?

questions.sentence: The president has promised to improve education ________________ he stays in power next year.
questions.explanation: Shart: agar u kelgusi yili hokimiyatda qolsa (if he stays in power).
questions.translation: Prezident agar kelasi yili hokimiyatda qolsa, ta'limni yaxshilashga va'da berdi.

questions.sentence: You ________________ find out what you’re capable of achieving unless you try.
questions.explanation: Harakat qilib ko'rmaguningizcha (unless you try), bilib ololmaysiz (you won't find out).
questions.translation: Urinib ko'rmaguningizcha, nimalarga qodir ekanligingizni bila olmaysiz.

questions.sentence: She ________________ make any progress unless she tries hard.
questions.explanation: Tirishib harakat qilmasa, o'sishga erisholmaydi (won't make any progress).
questions.translation: Qattiq harakat qilmasa, u hech qanday natijaga erisha olmaydi.

questions.sentence: The Prime Minister has promised to improve people’s life ________________ he stays in power next year.
questions.explanation: Shart ma'nosida: if he stays in power.
questions.translation: Bosh vazir agar hokimiyatda qolsa, xalq hayotini yaxshilashga va'da berdi.

questions.sentence: Air quality ________________ change for better side unless the world industries cut the pollution amount significantly.
questions.explanation: Unless sharti bilan natijada inkor: won't change for better side.
questions.translation: Dunyo sanoati ifloslanishni kamaytirmasa, havo sifati yaxshi tomonga o'zgarmaydi.

questions.sentence: You are paid more money at this company ________________ you work longer hours.
questions.explanation: Shart: agar ko'proq ishlasangiz (if you work longer hours).
questions.translation: Ushbu kompaniyada ko'proq soat ishlasangiz, sizga ko'proq pul to'lanadi.

questions.sentence: You won’t be considered as a good specialist ________________ you have enough work experience.
questions.explanation: 'unless you have enough work experience' = yetarli ish tajribangiz bo'lmasa.
questions.translation: Yetarli ish tajribangiz bo'lmasa, siz yaxshi mutaxassis deb hisoblanmaysiz.

questions.sentence: Unless the government deals with corruption, the quality of education ________________ get better.
questions.explanation: Korrupsiyaga qarshi kurashilmasa, ta'lim sifati oshmaydi (won't get better).
questions.translation: Hukumat korrupsiyaga qarshi kurashmasa, ta'lim sifati yaxshilanmaydi.

questions.sentence: Unless you learn all these words, you ________________ be allowed to take an exam.
questions.explanation: Barcha so'zlarni yodlamasangiz, imtihonga qo'yilmaysiz (won't be allowed).
questions.translation: Barcha bu so'zlarni o'rganmasangiz, imtihon topshirishga ruxsat berilmaysiz.

questions.sentence: The new Prime Minister has claimed that ________________ the current taxes are lowered, businesses will continue to hide real incomes.
questions.explanation: 'unless current taxes are lowered' = soliqlar tushirilmasa, daromadlarini yashirishda davom etishadi.
questions.translation: Bosh vazir agar amaldagi soliqlar pasaytirilmasa, bizneslar real daromadlarini yashirishda davom etishini ta'kidladi.

questions.sentence: She won’t find a well-paid job ________________ she improves her English.
questions.explanation: Ingliz tilini yaxshilamasa, yaxshi maoshli ish topolmaydi.
questions.translation: Ingliz tilini yaxshilamasa, u yuqori maoshli ish topa olmaydi.

questions.sentence: ________________ Samuel is admitted to Stanford University, he will definitely be happy!
questions.explanation: Boshida bosh harf bilan: If Samuel is admitted... (Agar Stenfordga qabul qilinsa).
questions.translation: Agar Samuel Stenford universitetiga qabul qilinsa, u albatta juda xursand bo'ladi!

questions.sentence: Bill Gates started the Microsoft Corporation in 1975. → The Microsoft Corporation ________________ by Bill Gates in 1975.
questions.explanation: Past Simple Active (started) → Past Simple Passive (was/were + V3: was started).
questions.translation: Maykrosoft korporatsiyasiga 1975-yilda Bill Geyts tomonidan asos solingan.

questions.sentence: People are setting up new independent cafés all the time. → New independent cafés ________________ all the time.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous Active (are setting up) → Present Continuous Passive (are being set up).
questions.translation: Hozirda doimiy ravishda yangi mustaqil kafelar ochilmoqda.

questions.sentence: The bank must review all applications for loans. → All applications for loans ________________.
questions.explanation: Modal fe'l majhul nisbati: modal + be + V3 (must be reviewed).
questions.translation: Kredit uchun barcha arizalar ko'rib chiqilishi shart.

questions.sentence: The government has set up a website for people wanting to start a company. → A website ________________ for people wanting to start a company.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Active (has set up) → Present Perfect Passive (has been set up).
questions.translation: Kompaniya ochmoqchi bo'lganlar uchun veb-sayt ishga tushirildi.

questions.sentence: No one knows if the global crisis will affect any more countries. → No one knows if any more countries ________________.
questions.explanation: Future Simple Passive: will be + V3 (will be affected).
questions.translation: Global inqiroz yana boshqa davlatlarga ta'sir qiladimi-yo'qmi, hech kim bilmaydi.

questions.sentence: It is not certain if this economic collapse will hit any more countries. → It is not certain if any more countries ________________.
questions.explanation: Future Simple Passive: will be + hit (V3).
questions.translation: Iqtisodiy qulash boshqa mamlakatlarga ham zarba beradimi, noaniq.

questions.sentence: Young entrepreneurs are creating various new types of business year by year. → Various new types of business ________________ year by year.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous Passive: are being created.
questions.translation: Yildan-yilga yosh tadbirkorlar tomonidan yangi biznes turlari yaratilmoqda.

questions.sentence: The government has launched an official website to support newly started businessmen. → An official website ________________ to support newly started businessmen.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Passive: has been launched.
questions.translation: Yangi boshlagan tadbirkorlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun rasmiy veb-sayt ishga tushirildi.

questions.sentence: Winklevoss brothers created the idea of Facebook. → The idea of Facebook ________________ by Winklevoss brothers.
questions.explanation: Past Simple Passive: was created.
questions.translation: Facebook g'oyasi Uinklvoss aka-ukalari tomonidan yaratilgan.

questions.sentence: The government is providing cheap accommodation to poor families these days. → Cheap accommodation ________________ these days.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous Passive: is being provided (accommodation sanalmaydi, 'is' oladi).
questions.translation: Hozirgi kunlarda kam ta'minlangan oilalarga arzon uy-joylar taqdim etilmoqda.

questions.sentence: The university must announce all the exam results soon. → All the exam results ________________ soon.
questions.explanation: Modal passive: must be announced.
questions.translation: Yaqin orada universitet barcha imtihon natijalarini e'lon qilishi kerak.

questions.sentence: The company has launched a new application for English learners. → A new application ________________ for English learners.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Passive: has been launched.
questions.translation: Ingliz tili o'rganuvchilari uchun yangi ilova chiqarildi.

questions.sentence: In the future, most companies will hire employees based on their creativity rather than knowledge. → In the future, employees ________________ based on their creativity rather than knowledge.
questions.explanation: Future Simple Passive: will be hired.
questions.translation: Kelajakda xodimlar bilimdan ko'ra ko'proq ijodkorliklariga qarab ishga qabul qilinadi.

questions.sentence: J.K. Rowling wrote Harry Potter books in a café near her apartment. → Harry Potter books ________________ by J.K. Rowling in a café near her apartment.
questions.explanation: Books ko'plikda bo'lgani uchun: were written.
questions.translation: Garri Potter kitoblari J.K. Rouling tomonidan uning uyi yaqinidagi kafeda yozilgan.

questions.sentence: The government is building new hospitals in Rochester. → New hospitals ________________ in Rochester.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous Passive: are being built.
questions.translation: Rochester shahrida yangi shifoxonalar qurilmoqda.

questions.sentence: The company must fire the IT department if they do not understand the organizational culture. → The IT department ________________ if they don’t understand the organizational culture.
questions.explanation: Modal passive: must be fired.
questions.translation: IT bo'limi agar tashkiliy madaniyatni tushunmasa, ishdan bo'shatilishi shart.

questions.sentence: The state has created an online platform for paying taxes. → An online platform ________________ by the state for paying taxes.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Passive: has been created.
questions.translation: Soliqlarni to'lash uchun davlat tomonidan onlayn platforma yaratildi.

questions.sentence: In the future, car manufacturing companies will produce electric cars on a large scale. → In the future, electric cars ________________ on a large scale by car manufacturing companies.
questions.explanation: Future Simple Passive: will be produced.
questions.translation: Kelajakda elektromobillar avtomobil ishlab chiqaruvchilar tomonidan keng miqyosda ishlab chiqariladi.

title: 4. Comparisons & Modifiers
titleUz: Qiyoslash: taller, less, just as, a lot
description: Qiyoslash darajalari: not as...as, just as...as, less than, a lot better

questions.sentence: Sardor isn’t as tall as Bakhrom. (taller) → Bakhrom ________________ Sardor.
questions.explanation: Sardor Bahromchalik baland emas = Bahrom Sardordan balandroq (is taller than).
questions.translation: Bahrom Sardordan balandroq.

questions.sentence: In my opinion, Samarkand is more exciting than Tashkent. (less) → In my opinion, Tashkent is ________________ Samarkand.
questions.explanation: more exciting than teskarisi: less exciting than (kamroq hayajonli).
questions.translation: Mening fikrimcha, Toshkent Samarqandga qaraganda kamroq qiziqarli.

questions.sentence: Beauty and intelligence are both important to me. (just) → Beauty ________________ as intelligence to me.
questions.explanation: Ikkisi teng muhim: is just as important as...
questions.translation: Go'zallik men uchun aql bilan bir xilda muhim.

questions.sentence: Some people are less confident about their looks than others. (as) → Some people ________________ as others about their looks.
questions.explanation: less confident than = are not as confident as (boshqalarchalik ishonchli emas).
questions.translation: Ba'zi odamlar tashqi ko'rinishlariga boshqalarchalik ishonishmaydi.

questions.sentence: My new brand of lipstick is far better than my old brand. (a lot) → My new brand of lipstick ________________ than my old brand.
questions.explanation: far better = a lot better (ancha yaxshiroq).
questions.translation: Yangi lab bo'yog'im eskisidan ancha yaxshiroq.

questions.sentence: The Amudarya isn’t as long as the Syrdarya. (longer) → The Syrdarya ________________ the Amudarya.
questions.explanation: Amudaryo Sirdaryochalik uzun emas = Sirdaryo Amudaryodan uzunroq (is longer than).
questions.translation: Sirdaryo Amudaryodan uzunroq.

questions.sentence: Both quality and quantity are equally important to the company. (just) → Quality ________________ quantity to the company.
questions.explanation: Teng muhimlik: is just as important as.
questions.translation: Kompaniya uchun sifat miqdor kabi bir xilda muhim.

questions.sentence: In my mind, outdoor games are more useful than indoor games. (less) → In my mind, indoor games are ________________ than outdoor games.
questions.explanation: Teskari qiyos: indoor games are less useful than outdoor games.
questions.translation: Menimcha, uy ichidagi o'yinlar ochiq havodagi o'yinlardan ko'ra kamroq foydali.

questions.sentence: My new smart phone is far better than my old one. (a lot) → My new smart phone ________________ than my old one.
questions.explanation: far better = is a lot better.
questions.translation: Yangi smartfonim eskisidan ancha yaxshiroq.

questions.sentence: Some online shops are less confident about their goods and services than others. (as) → Some online shops ________________ as others about their good and services.
questions.explanation: less confident = are not as confident as.
questions.translation: Ba'zi internet-do'konlar o'z tovar va xizmatlariga boshqalarchalik ishonch hosil qilishmagan.

questions.sentence: Michael isn’t as tall as Joe. (taller) → Joe ________________ Michael.
questions.explanation: is taller than Michael.
questions.translation: Jo Maykldan balandroq.

questions.sentence: In my opinion, Dubai is more exciting than Istanbul. (less) → In my opinion, Istanbul is ________________ Dubai.
questions.explanation: less exciting than.
questions.translation: Fikrimcha, Istanbul Dubayga qaraganda kamroq qiziqarli.

questions.sentence: Talents and skills are equally important. (just) → Talents ________________ skills.
questions.explanation: Ko'plikda: are just as important as.
questions.translation: Iqtidor va ko'nikmalar bir xilda muhimdir.

questions.sentence: Some animals are less dangerous than others. (as) → Some animals ________________ as others.
questions.explanation: are not as dangerous as.
questions.translation: Ba'zi hayvonlar boshqalar kabi xavfli emas.

questions.sentence: My new laptop is far better than the old one. (a lot) → My new laptop ________________ than the old one.
questions.explanation: is a lot better.
questions.translation: Yangi noutbukim eskisidan ancha yaxshiroq.

questions.sentence: Boris isn’t as smart as Kevin. (than) → Kevin ________________ Boris.
questions.explanation: is smarter than.
questions.translation: Kevin Borisdan aqlliroq.

questions.sentence: I think Los Angeles is more beautiful than New York. (less) → I think New York is ________________ Los Angeles.
questions.explanation: less beautiful than.
questions.translation: Menimcha, Nyu-York Los-Anjelesdan kamroq go'zal.

questions.sentence: Las Vegas and San Francisco are both very expensive. (just) → Las Vegas ________________ San Francisco.
questions.explanation: is just as expensive as.
questions.translation: Las-Vegas San-Fransisko kabi bir xilda qimmat.

questions.sentence: European companies are less profitable than Chinese companies. (as) → European companies ________________ as Chinese companies.
questions.explanation: are not as profitable as.
questions.translation: Yevropa kompaniyalari Xitoy kompaniyalari kabi serdaromad emas.

questions.sentence: My new house is far better than the old one. (lot) → My old house ________________ than the new one.
questions.explanation: Yangi uy ancha yaxshi = eski uy ancha yomonroq (is a lot worse).
questions.translation: Eski uyim yangisidan ancha yomonroq.

title: 5. Past Regrets: should have / shouldn't have
description: O'tgan zamondagi xatolar va afsuslanishlar: should have + V3 / shouldn't have + V3

questions.sentence: Raul didn’t remember to set his alarm and woke up late. → He ________________ to set his alarm. (forget)
questions.explanation: U budilnik qo'yishni unutmasligi kerak edi (shouldn't have forgotten).
questions.translation: U budilnik qo'yishni unutmasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: He hadn’t packed the night before, so had to do it in the morning. → He ________________ his packing until the morning. (leave)
questions.explanation: Yuklarini ertalabgacha qoldirmasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have left.
questions.translation: U yuklarini yig'ishtirishni ertalabga qoldirmasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: Traffic was terrible and it would have been quicker to walk. → He ________________ to the station. (walk)
questions.explanation: Piyoda borgani ma'qul edi: he should have walked.
questions.translation: U vokzalga piyoda borishi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: He ordered coffee and was waiting to pay when the train arrived. → He ________________ a coffee. (buy)
questions.explanation: Kofe sotib olmasligi kerak edi: he shouldn't have bought.
questions.translation: U kofe sotib olmasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: He had booked non-refundable ticket in advance and lost money. → He ________________ his ticket three weeks in advance. (book)
questions.explanation: Chiptani 3 hafta oldin band qilmasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have booked.
questions.translation: U chiptani 3 hafta oldin band qilmasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: Andrew stayed up till midnight and missed his morning flight. → He ________________ up till midnight. (stay)
questions.explanation: Yarim tungacha uyg'oq o'tirmasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have stayed.
questions.translation: U yarim tungacha bedor o'tirmasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: Andrew completely forgot to set up his alarm. → He ________________ to set his alarm. (forget)
questions.explanation: Budilnik qo'yishni unutmasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have forgotten.
questions.translation: U budilnikni qo'yishni unutmasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: Traffic was terrible, so walking would have been much faster. → He ________________ to the airport. (walk)
questions.explanation: Aeroportga piyoda borishi kerak edi: should have walked.
questions.translation: U aeroportga piyoda borishi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: At passport control he realized he had left his passport at home. → He ________________ his passport at home. (leave)
questions.explanation: Pasportini uyda qoldirmasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have left.
questions.translation: U pasportini uyda unutib qoldirmasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: He missed his flight because he wasn't punctual. → He ________________ more punctual. (be)
questions.explanation: Aniq va intizomli bo'lishi kerak edi: should have been.
questions.translation: U vaqtga aniqroq bo'lishi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: Tommy failed his exam because he didn’t start studying early. → He ________________ preparing for the exam earlier. (start)
questions.explanation: Imtihonga ertaroq tayyorgarlik ko'rishni boshlashi kerak edi: should have started.
questions.translation: U imtihonga ertaroq tayyorgarlik ko'rishni boshlashi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: The night before exam, he went to the local pub with friends. → He ________________ to the local pub with his friends. (go)
questions.explanation: Pabga bormasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have gone.
questions.translation: U do'stlari bilan pabga bormasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: The traffic was terrible, so bus was a bad choice. → He ________________ the bus to university. (get)
questions.explanation: Avtobusga o'tirmasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have got.
questions.translation: U universitetga avtobusda bormasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: He stopped to buy coffee and lost critical time. → He ________________ to buy coffee. (stop)
questions.explanation: Kofe olishga to'xtamasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have stopped.
questions.translation: U kofe olish uchun to'xtamasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: He talked for 10 minutes with Arthur and arrived late. → He ________________ to his friend Arthur. (talk)
questions.explanation: Do'sti bilan uzoq gaplashib turmasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have talked.
questions.translation: U do'sti Artur bilan gaplashib turmasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: Richard drank too much alcohol and got into trouble. → He ________________ too much alcohol. (drink)
questions.explanation: Ko'p spirtli ichimlik ichmasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have drunk.
questions.translation: U ortiqcha spirtli ichimlik ichmasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: He insulted people at the stadium because he was drunk. → He ________________ people at the stadium. (insult)
questions.explanation: Odamlarni haqorat qilmasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have insulted.
questions.translation: U stadiondagi odamlarni haqorat qilmasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: He ruined his career by aggressive behavior. → He ________________ himself politely. (behave)
questions.explanation: O'zini xushmuomala tutishi kerak edi: should have behaved.
questions.translation: U o'zini odobli tutishi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: A man tried to stop them but Richard hit him. → He ________________ the man at the stadium. (hit)
questions.explanation: Odamni urmasligi kerak edi: shouldn't have hit (hit fe'lining V3 shakli ham hit).
questions.translation: U stadiondagi odamni urmasligi kerak edi.

questions.sentence: He ruined his great boxing potential. → He ________________ about his future career. (think)
questions.explanation: Kelajakdagi faoliyati haqida o'ylashi kerak edi: should have thought.
questions.translation: U kelajakdagi faoliyati haqida o'ylashi kerak edi.

title: 6. Third Conditional
titleUz: Uchinchi tur shart mayli (If had V3, would have V3)
description: O'tgan zamondagi amalga oshmagan voqea-hodisalar va ularning natijalari

questions.sentence: I suppose that if he had had more money …
options: he would steal that woman’s purse.
he hasn’t stolen that woman’s purse.
he wouldn’t have stolen that woman’s purse.
questions.correctAnswer: he wouldn’t have stolen that woman’s purse.
questions.explanation: If + Past Perfect (had had) → would have + V3: wouldn't have stolen.
questions.translation: Agar uning ko'proq puli bo'lganida, u ayolning hamyonini o'g'irlamagan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: Masa might not have been arrested …
options: if he hits the other man.
if he wouldn’t have hit the other man.
if he hadn’t hit the other man.
questions.correctAnswer: if he hadn’t hit the other man.
questions.explanation: Shart qismida: if + Past Perfect (if he hadn't hit).
questions.translation: Agar Masa boshqa kishini urmaganida, hibsga olinmagan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: If the police hadn’t caught the thieves in time …
options: they would probably have taken everything.
questions.correctAnswer: they would probably have taken everything.
questions.explanation: Natija qismida: would have + V3: would probably have taken.
questions.translation: Agar politsiya o'g'rilarni o'z vaqtida ushlamaganda, ular hamma narsani olib ketishgan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: Daniel couldn’t have burgled anyone’s house …
options: if he had been in prison.
if he would have been in prison.
questions.correctAnswer: if he had been in prison.
questions.explanation: If + had been (qamoqda bo'lganida, talonchilik qilolmasdi).
questions.translation: Agar Daniel qamoqda bo'lganida, hech kimning uyini tunay olmas edi.

questions.sentence: If they hadn’t left their bags in the restaurant …
questions.explanation: Sumkalarini restoranda qoldirishmaganda, ular o'g'irlanmagan bo'lardi: wouldn't have been stolen.
questions.translation: Agar ular sumkalarini restoranda qoldirib ketishmaganida, o'g'irlanmas edi.

questions.sentence: Jack might not have been arrested …
options: if he hits the other man.
if he have hit the other man.
if he hadn’t hit the other man.
questions.correctAnswer: if he hadn’t hit the other man.
questions.explanation: if + hadn't hit the other man.
questions.translation: Jek agar boshqa kishini urmaganida, hibsga olinmas edi.

questions.sentence: If Jack hadn’t left his bag in the restaurant …
questions.explanation: it wouldn't have been stolen.
questions.translation: Jek sumkasini restoranda qoldirmaganida, o'g'irlanmas edi.

questions.sentence: Daniel couldn’t have burgled anyone’s house …
options: if he is already in prison.
if he had been put in prison.
questions.correctAnswer: if he had been put in prison.
questions.explanation: if + had been put in prison.
questions.translation: Agar Daniel qamoqqa tashlanganida, hech kimning uyini tunay olmas edi.

questions.sentence: I guess that if Carol had had more money, …
options: he wouldn’t have worked extra hours
questions.correctAnswer: he wouldn’t have worked extra hours
questions.explanation: wouldn't have worked extra hours.
questions.translation: Menimcha, Kerolning ko'proq puli bo'lganida, ortiqcha ishlamagan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: Megan might not have been fired …
options: if she has an argument with the boss.
if she wouldn’t have had an argument with the boss.
if she hadn’t had an argument with the boss.
questions.correctAnswer: if she hadn’t had an argument with the boss.
questions.explanation: if + had not had (Past Perfect: hadn't had an argument).
questions.translation: Megan agar boshliq bilan tortishmaganida, ishdan bo'shatilmagan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: If the government hadn’t increased taxes, …
options: it would have caused budget deficit
questions.correctAnswer: it would have caused budget deficit
questions.explanation: it would have caused budget deficit.
questions.translation: Hukumat soliqlarni oshirmaganda, bu byudjet taqchilligiga olib kelgan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: James would have come to the party …
options: if he would have been invited
questions.explanation: if + Past Perfect Passive (if he had been invited).
questions.translation: Jeyms mehmondorchilikka taklif qilinganida, albatta kelgan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: If the police hadn’t arrested them, …
options: they would commit a crime again
they would have committed a crime again.
they have committed a crime again
questions.correctAnswer: they would have committed a crime again.
questions.explanation: they would have committed a crime again.
questions.translation: Agar politsiya ularni ushlamaganda, ular yana jinoyat sodir etgan bo'lardilar.

questions.sentence: I think if she had called him, …
questions.explanation: he would have answered.
questions.translation: O'ylaymanki, agar u unga qo'ng'iroq qilganida, u javob bergan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: Sally might not have been kidnapped …
options: if she doesn’t talk to a stranger
if she hadn’t talked to a stranger
if she would talk to a stranger
questions.correctAnswer: if she hadn’t talked to a stranger
questions.explanation: if she hadn't talked to a stranger.
questions.translation: Salli notanish odam bilan gaplashmaganida, o'g'irlab ketilmagan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: If the company hadn’t increased salaries, …
options: it would have decreased employees’ motivation
questions.correctAnswer: it would have decreased employees’ motivation
questions.explanation: it would have decreased employees' motivation.
questions.translation: Agar kompaniya maoshlarni oshirmaganda, xodimlarning ishtiyoqi pasayib ketgan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: Margo would have invited Jim to the party …
options: if they hadn’t had an argument
if they don’t have an argument
if they would have an argument
questions.correctAnswer: if they hadn’t had an argument
questions.explanation: if they hadn't had an argument.
questions.translation: Margo Jim bilan urishib qolmaganida, uni ziyofatga taklif qilgan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: If Clara had applied for this job earlier, …
questions.explanation: Modal natija: she could have been hired (ishga qabul qilinishi mumkin edi).
questions.translation: Klara agar bu ishga ertaroq ariza topshirganida, ishga olingan bo'lishi mumkin edi.

questions.sentence: If the doctor hadn't arrived so quickly, …
questions.explanation: would have + V3: would have died.
questions.translation: Shifokor tez yetib kelmaganida, bemor vafot etgan bo'lardi.

questions.sentence: We wouldn't have missed our train …
options: if we had taken a taxi.
if we would take a taxi.
questions.correctAnswer: if we had taken a taxi.
questions.explanation: if + Past Perfect: if we had taken a taxi.
questions.translation: Taksi olganimizda poyezddan kechikmagan bo'lardik.

title: 7. Reported Speech: Questions
description: Ko'chirma so'roq gaplarni o'zlashtirma gapga aylantirish (asked if / asked what...)

questions.sentence: ‘Do customers like the new product?’ → He asked the manager ________________.
options: if customers liked the new product
did customers like the new product
if customers like the new product
that customers liked the new product
questions.correctAnswer: if customers liked the new product
questions.explanation: Present Simple (like) o'zlashtirma gapda Past Simple (liked) ga o'zgaradi va 'if' qo'yiladi.
questions.translation: U menejerdan xaridorlarga yangi mahsulot yoqqan-yoqmaganligini so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Have children finished studying for exams?’ → She asked me ________________.
options: if children had finished studying for exams
have children finished studying for exams
questions.correctAnswer: if children had finished studying for exams
questions.explanation: Present Perfect (have finished) → Past Perfect (had finished).
questions.translation: U mendan bolalar imtihonga tayyorgarlikni tugatishganmi-yo'qmi, so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Did Jack see the news yesterday evening?’ → They asked her ________________.
options: if Jack had seen the news the previous evening
did Jack see the news yesterday
if Jack saw the news yesterday
if Jack has seen the news
questions.correctAnswer: if Jack had seen the news the previous evening
questions.explanation: Past Simple (did see) → Past Perfect (had seen), yesterday evening → the previous evening.
questions.translation: Ular undan Jek kecha oqshom yangiliklarni ko'rgan-ko'rmaganligini so'rashdi.

questions.sentence: ‘What do critics think about these documentaries?’ → He asked us ________________.
options: what critics thought about those documentaries
what did critics think about these documentaries
what critics think about those documentaries
questions.correctAnswer: what critics thought about those documentaries
questions.explanation: Maxsus so'roq so'zi (what) saqlanadi, 'think' → 'thought', 'these' → 'those'.
questions.translation: U bizdan tanqidchilar ushbu hujjatli filmlar haqida nima deb o'ylashlarini so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘What are employees going to do in their new jobs?’ → She asked the HR manager ________________.
options: what employees were going to do in their new jobs
what are employees going to do in their new jobs
what were employees going to do
what employees are going to do
questions.correctAnswer: what employees were going to do in their new jobs
questions.explanation: 'are going to' → 'were going to' va darak gap tartibi (employees were going to do).
questions.translation: U HR menejerdan xodimlar yangi ishlarida nima qilishlarini so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Does Mr Smith like the new product?’ → The sales manager asked him ________________.
options: if Mr Smith liked the new product
did Mr Smith like the new product
does Mr Smith like the new product
whether Mr Smith likes the new product
questions.correctAnswer: if Mr Smith liked the new product
questions.explanation: Does like → liked va if qo'shiladi.
questions.translation: Sotuvlar menejeri janob Smitga yangi mahsulot yoqqan-yoqmaganligini so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Has the mechanic finished fixing the car?’ → She asked her husband ________________.
options: if the mechanic had finished fixing the car
has the mechanic finished fixing the car
if the mechanic finished fixing the car
questions.correctAnswer: if the mechanic had finished fixing the car
questions.explanation: Has finished → had finished.
questions.translation: U eridan usta mashinani tuzatib bo'lgan-bo'lmaganligini so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Did students take part in the conference yesterday?’ → He asked students ________________.
options: if they had taken part in the conference the day before
did students take part in the conference yesterday
questions.correctAnswer: if they had taken part in the conference the day before
questions.explanation: Did take part → had taken part, yesterday → the day before.
questions.translation: U talabalardan kecha konferensiyada qatnashgan-qatnashmaganliklarini so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Which country are freshmen going to travel next year?’ → My friend asked me ________________.
options: which country freshmen were going to travel the following year
which country are freshmen going to travel next year
which country were freshmen going to travel
if freshmen were going to travel
questions.correctAnswer: which country freshmen were going to travel the following year
questions.explanation: are going to → were going to, next year → the following year.
questions.translation: Do'stim mendan birinchi kurs talabalari kelasi yili qaysi davlatga sayohat qilishlarini so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Do children enjoy watching cartoons?’ → He asked me ________________.
questions.explanation: enjoy → enjoyed.
questions.translation: U mendan bolalar multfilm ko'rishni yoqtiradimi-yo'qmi, so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Have students finished the coursework?’ → She asked the teacher ________________.
options: if students had finished the coursework
questions.correctAnswer: if students had finished the coursework
questions.explanation: have finished → had finished.
questions.translation: U o'qituvchidan talabalar kurs ishini tugatgan-tugatmaganliklarini so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Did everyone hear the news about John?’ → They asked us ________________.
options: if everyone had heard the news about John
did everyone hear the news about John
questions.correctAnswer: if everyone had heard the news about John
questions.explanation: did hear → had heard.
questions.translation: Ular bizdan hamma Jon haqidagi yangilikni eshitgan-eshitmaganligini so'rashdi.

questions.sentence: ‘What do graduates want to do after university?’ → He asked the professor ________________.
options: what graduates wanted to do after university
what did graduates want to do
what do graduates want to do
questions.correctAnswer: what graduates wanted to do after university
questions.explanation: want → wanted va darak so'z tartibi.
questions.translation: U professordan bitiruvchilar universitetdan keyin nima qilishni xohlashlarini so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Where are the Smiths going to fly tomorrow?’ → She asked them ________________.
options: where the Smiths were going to fly the next day
where are the Smiths going to fly tomorrow
where were the Smiths going to fly tomorrow
where the Smiths are going to fly
questions.correctAnswer: where the Smiths were going to fly the next day
questions.explanation: are going to → were going to, tomorrow → the next day.
questions.translation: U ulardan Smitlar oilasi ertaga qayerga uchib ketmoqchi ekanligini so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Do you like reading novels?’ → He asked ________________.
options: if do I like reading novels
questions.explanation: You → I, like → liked.
questions.translation: U mendan romanlar o'qishni yoqtirasizmi, deb so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Have you bought vegetables?’ → She asked ________________.
questions.explanation: have bought → had bought.
questions.translation: U sabzavotlar sotib olganimni so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Did you do the washing-up?’ → He asked ________________.
options: if I had done the washing-up
whether had I done the washing-up
questions.correctAnswer: if I had done the washing-up
questions.explanation: did do → had done.
questions.translation: U idishlarni yuvgan-yuvmaganimni so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Where do you want to live after marriage?’ → They asked ________________.
options: where I wanted to live after marriage
where do I want to live after marriage
where did I want to live
questions.correctAnswer: where I wanted to live after marriage
questions.explanation: where I wanted to live.
questions.translation: Ular to'ydan keyin qayerda yashashni xohlashimni so'rashdi.

questions.sentence: ‘When is he going to call back?’ → She asked ________________.
options: when he was going to call back
when is he going to call back
when was he going to call back
if he was going to call back
questions.correctAnswer: when he was going to call back
questions.explanation: is going to → was going to.
questions.translation: U uning qachon qayta qo'ng'iroq qilishini so'radi.

questions.sentence: ‘Can you speak French fluently?’ → They asked me ________________.
options: if I could speak French fluently
questions.correctAnswer: if I could speak French fluently
questions.explanation: can → could.
questions.translation: Ular mendan fransuz tilida ravon gapira olishimni so'rashdi.

title: 8. Vocabulary: Work & Career
description: Ish va faoliyat so'zlari: salary, working hours, accommodation, redundant, job satisfaction, qualification

questions.sentence: For many people, the Middle East is a great place to work. The average ________________ is very high, which means that you can save a lot of money.
questions.explanation: salary = maosh. O'rtacha maosh juda yuqori.
questions.translation: O'rtacha maosh juda yuqori, bu esa ko'p pul jamg'arish imkonini beradi.

questions.sentence: Some jobs in Dubai come with rent-free ________________ so you don’t need to worry about finding somewhere to live.
questions.explanation: accommodation = yashash joyi / turar joy. Rent-free accommodation = bepul turar joy.
questions.translation: Ba'zi ishlar bepul turar joy bilan ta'minlanadi.

questions.sentence: The ________________ are usually from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. from Sundays to Thursdays.
questions.explanation: working hours = ish soatlari (ertalab 9 dan kechki 6 gacha).
questions.translation: Ish soatlari odatda ertalab 9 dan kechki 6 gacha.

questions.sentence: If your company decides that they can no longer keep you and make you ________________, there are laws to protect you.
questions.explanation: make redundant = shtat qisqarishi sababli ishdan bo'shatish.
questions.translation: Agar kompaniya sizni shtat qisqarishi sababli ishdan bo'shatsa, sizni himoya qiluvchi qonunlar mavjud.

questions.sentence: It’s easy to see why employees report a good level of ________________ and recommend working abroad!
questions.explanation: job satisfaction = ishdan qoniqish hissi.
questions.translation: Xodimlar nima uchun ishdan yuqori darajada qoniqish his qilishlarini tushunish oson.

questions.sentence: First of all, one of the most important things is ________________ because it is vital to earn enough money for living.
questions.explanation: salary = maosh (yashash uchun yetarli pul topish).
questions.translation: Eng muhim narsalardan biri bu maoshdir, chunki yashash uchun pul topish zarur.

questions.sentence: Some companies even provide free ________________ for foreign specialists so they don’t have to worry about a place to live.
questions.explanation: free accommodation = bepul yashash joyi.
questions.translation: Ba'zi kompaniyalar xorijiy mutaxassislar uchun bepul turar joy bilan ta'minlaydi.

questions.sentence: Another significant factor is ________________ because people want to have enough free time for their families and private life.
questions.explanation: working hours = ish vaqti / soatlari.
questions.translation: Yana bir muhim omil — bu ish soatlari, chunki odamlar oilasi uchun bo'sh vaqtga ega bo'lishni xohlashadi.

questions.sentence: However, in order to work for companies providing good facilities, employees should have higher ________________.
questions.explanation: qualification = malaka / mutaxassislik darajasi.
questions.translation: Biroq, yaxshi sharoitlarga ega kompaniyalarda ishlash uchun xodimlar yuqoriroq malakaga ega bo'lishi kerak.

questions.sentence: Google employees get high ________________, much more in comparison with employees of other companies.
questions.explanation: high salary = yuqori maosh.
questions.translation: Google xodimlari boshqa kompaniyalarga qaraganda ancha yuqori maosh oladilar.

questions.sentence: The company hires people of different ________________ such as software developers, web designers, and marketing specialists.
questions.explanation: occupation = kasb / faoliyat turi.
questions.translation: Kompaniya dasturchilar, dizaynerlar kabi turli kasb egalarini ishga oladi.

questions.sentence: Taking all factors into consideration, Google employees have a high level of ________________ because everyone is happy to work here.
questions.explanation: high level of job satisfaction = ishdan yuqori darajada mamnunlik.
questions.translation: Barcha omillarni hisobga olsak, Google xodimlarining ishdan qoniqish darajasi juda yuqori.

title: 9. Vocabulary: Word Formation (Prefixes)
titleUz: Lug'at: So'z yasovchi qo'shimchalar (in-, over-, mis-, re-)
description: Old qo'shimchalar: mis- (noto'g'ri), re- (qayta), over- (ortiqcha), in-/un- (inkor)

questions.sentence: You must have ________________ the directions. This is nowhere near where we’re meant to be. (understand)
questions.explanation: misunderstand = noto'g'ri tushunmoq. O'tgan zamonda: misunderstood.
questions.translation: Siz yo'nalishni noto'g'ri tushungan bo'lsangiz kerak. Biz bo'lishimiz kerak bo'lgan joyga umuman yaqin emas.

questions.sentence: If you can’t make the meeting on Monday morning, you’ll just have to ________________ it. (arrange)
questions.explanation: rearrange = vaqtini qayta belgilamoq / boshqa kunga ko'chirmoq.
questions.translation: Agar dushanba kuni ertalab yig'ilishga kela olmasangiz, uni boshqa kunga ko'chirishga to'g'ri keladi.

questions.sentence: Our flight was cancelled due to bad weather, which was extremely ________________. (convenient)
questions.explanation: inconvenient = noqulay, qiyinchilik tug'diruvchi.
questions.translation: Parvozimiz yomon ob-havo tufayli bekor qilindi, bu juda noqulay bo'ldi.

questions.sentence: After going missing in 1926, the writer Agatha Christie ________________ ten days later at a hotel. (appear)
questions.explanation: reappear = qayta paydo bo'lmoq / ko'rinish bermoq.
questions.translation: 1926-yilda g'oyib bo'lganidan so'ng, Agata Kristi o'n kundan keyin mehmonxonada qayta paydo bo'ldi.

questions.sentence: Many people are guilty of ________________ on things they don’t really need, like clothes or jewellery. (spend)
questions.explanation: overspend = ortiqcha / haddan tashqari ko'p pul sarflamoq.
questions.translation: Ko'p odamlar aslida kerak bo'lmagan kiyim yoki taqinchoqlarga haddan tashqari ko'p pul sarflashadi.

questions.sentence: Sarah cannot come to the meeting due to personal issues. We will have to ________________ the meeting. (arrange)
questions.explanation: rearrange the meeting = uchrashuvni qayta rejalashtirmoq.
questions.translation: Sara kela olmaydi. Yig'ilishni boshqa kunga ko'chirishimiz kerak.

questions.sentence: If you ________________, I will tell your parents and they will punish you. (behave)
questions.explanation: misbehave = o'zini yomon tutmoq, bezorilik qilmoq.
questions.translation: Agar nojo'ya harakat qilsang, ota-onangga aytaman va ular seni jazolaydilar.

questions.sentence: My back hurts because bus seats were so ________________. (comfortable)
questions.explanation: uncomfortable = noqulay / qulay bo'lmagan.
questions.translation: Avtobus o'rindiqlari juda noqulay bo'lgani uchun belim og'riyapti.

questions.sentence: I think she ________________ me. I didn’t want to say anything wrong. (understand)
questions.explanation: misunderstood = meni noto'g'ri tushundi.
questions.translation: Menimcha, u meni noto'g'ri tushundi. Men yomon narsa aytmoqchi emasdim.

questions.sentence: I don’t understand people who buy ________________ things. There are so many cheaper alternatives. (priced)
questions.explanation: overpriced = narxi asossiz qimmat / haddan tashqari qimmat.
questions.translation: Haddan tashqari qimmat narsalarni sotib oladigan odamlarni tushunmayman.

questions.sentence: Travelling by bus is so ________________, it is very crowded and takes a lot of time. (convenient)
questions.explanation: inconvenient = noqulay.
questions.translation: Avtobusda yurish juda noqulay, u juda gavjum va ko'p vaqt oladi.

questions.sentence: I think this dress is ________________. I won’t buy it for $1500! (priced)
questions.explanation: overpriced = haddan tashqari qimmat.
questions.translation: Bu ko'ylak juda qimmat deb hisoblayman. Men uni 1500 dollarga sotib olmayman!

title: 10. Vocabulary: HAVE vs TAKE
description: HAVE va TAKE fe'llari bilan bog'liq turg'un birikmalar

questions.sentence: My company gets tickets for big matches, so I thought I’d ________________ advantage of it this time!
questions.explanation: take advantage of = foydalanib qolmoq / imkoniyatdan foydalanmoq.
questions.translation: Kompaniyam chiptalar oladi, shuning uchun bu safar fursatdan foydalanib qolay dedim!

questions.sentence: Is it all right if I ________________ a word with my wife and let you know?
questions.explanation: have a word with someone = biror kishi bilan gaplashib olmoq.
questions.translation: Xotinim bilan gaplashib olib, keyin sizga xabar qilsam maylimi?

questions.sentence: I ________________ a feeling that she’s invited some friends over that day.
questions.explanation: have a feeling = ko'nglim sezmoqda / his qilyapman.
questions.translation: Ko'nglim sezyaptiki, u o'sha kuni do'stlarini mehmonga chaqirgan.

questions.sentence: I know she invited friends, but I don’t ________________ a clue at what time.
questions.explanation: not have a clue = umuman tasavvurga ega bo'lmaslik / bilmaslik.
questions.translation: Lekin qaysi vaqtda ekanligi haqida hech qanday tasavvurim yo'q.

questions.sentence: ________________ my word for it – it’s going to be a great game!
questions.explanation: Take my word for it = gapimga ishon / mening so'zimga ishonaver.
questions.translation: Mening gapimga ishonaver — ajoyib o'yin bo'ladi!

questions.sentence: We usually ________________ turns to go out on a Saturday while the other looks after the kids.
questions.explanation: take turns = navbatma-navbat qilmoq.
questions.translation: Biz odatda shanba kunlari navbatma-navbat ko'chaga chiqamiz.

questions.sentence: She ________________ care of the children while I am out.
questions.explanation: take care of = g'amxo'rlik qilmoq / qarab turmoq.
questions.translation: Men ko'chada bo'lganimda u bolalarga qarab turadi.

questions.sentence: It should be my turn to go out, but I can’t ________________ that for granted!
questions.explanation: take something for granted = o'z-o'zidan shunday bo'lishi kerak deb hisoblamoq / qadriga yetmaslik.
questions.translation: Mening navbatim bo'lishi kerak, lekin buni o'z-o'zidan shart deb bilolmayman!

questions.sentence: I understand – I don’t expect you to ________________ a decision before you speak to her.
questions.explanation: take a decision (or make a decision) = qaror qabul qilmoq.
questions.translation: Tushunaman — u bilan gaplashmasdan oldin qaror qabul qilishingizni kutmayman.

questions.sentence: I really hope I can make it, but I’ll let you know if I ________________ any difficulty arranging things!
questions.explanation: have difficulty (in doing something) = qiyinchilikka duch kelmoq.
questions.translation: Agar rejalashtirishda biror qiyinchilikka duch kelsam, sizga xabar beraman!

questions.sentence: They help us a lot and to be honest, I feel like ________________ it for granted!
questions.explanation: feel like taking it for granted = qadriga yetmayotgandek his qilmoq.
questions.translation: Ular bizga juda ko'p yordam berishadi va rostini aytsam, buni odatiy holdek qabul qilayotgandekman.

questions.sentence: I also have to ask my parents to ________________ care of the children tonight.
questions.explanation: take care of = qarab turmoq.
questions.translation: Shuningdek, ota-onamdan bugun oqshom bolalarga qarab turishlarini so'rashim kerak.

title: 11. Vocabulary: Describing People
description: Tashqi ko'rinish so'zlari: bald, dyed, elderly, eyelashes, fringe, moustache, overweight, shape, slim, well-built

questions.sentence: If you want to keep in good ________________, it’s advisable to do some exercise every day.
questions.explanation: keep in good shape = yaxshi jismoniy holatda bo'lmoq / qomatni saqlamoq.
questions.translation: Yaxshi qomatni saqlab qolishni istasangiz, har kuni mashq qilish tavsiya etiladi.

questions.sentence: My father started losing his hair in his thirties and now he’s completely ________________.
questions.explanation: bald = kal / sochsiz.
questions.translation: Otam o'ttiz yoshlarida sochini yo'qota boshlagan va hozir butunlay kal.

questions.sentence: Do you think Anya’s hair is ________________? I’m sure it used to be much lighter than it is now.
questions.explanation: dyed hair = bo'yalgan soch.
questions.translation: Sizningcha Anyaning sochi bo'yalganmi? Avval ancha ochroq rangda bo'lganiga ishonchim komil.

questions.sentence: Not playing any sport and eating too much are two main causes of becoming ________________.
questions.explanation: overweight = ortiqcha vaznli / semiz.
questions.translation: Sport bilan shug'ullanmaslik va ko'p ovqat yeyish ortiqcha vazn orttirishning ikkita asosiy sababidir.

questions.sentence: This dress is a bit tight and I’m not ________________ enough to wear it.
questions.explanation: slim = xushbichim / ozg'in.
questions.translation: Bu ko'ylak biroz tor va men uni kiyish uchun yetarlicha ozg'in emasman.

questions.sentence: Jessica always had really long hair but she decided to change it and now has it ________________-length.
questions.explanation: shoulder-length = yelkagacha tushib turadigan (soch).
questions.translation: Jessikaning sochi doim uzun edi, lekin u o'zgartirishga qaror qildi va hozir yelka uzunligida.

questions.sentence: When Ahmet was a little boy, he always wanted to grow a ________________ just like his dad!
questions.explanation: moustache = mo'ylov.
questions.translation: Ahmet kichkinaligida doim otasidek mo'ylov qo'yishni orzu qilardi!

questions.sentence: The hairdresser in my village offers a 20% discount for ________________ people over seventy years old.
questions.explanation: elderly people = keksalar / yoshi ulug' odamlar.
questions.translation: Qishlog'imdagi sartaroshxona yetmish yoshdan oshgan keksalar uchun 20% chegirma beradi.

questions.sentence: That girl’s ________________ is so long that I’m surprised she can see anything through it!
questions.explanation: fringe = kokil / peshona sochi (chelyolka).
questions.translation: U qizning kokili shunchalik uzunki, u qanday ko'rayotganiga hayronman!

questions.sentence: Chiara had beautiful eyes; they were green, with long, dark ________________.
questions.explanation: eyelashes = kipriklar.
questions.translation: Kiarada go'zal ko'zlar bor edi; uzun, qora kiprikli yashil ko'zlar.

questions.sentence: John is a very handsome and ________________ man. I guess he does sports almost every day.
questions.explanation: well-built = baquvvat, qomati kelishgan.
questions.translation: Jon juda kelishgan va baquvvat erkak. U deyarli har kuni sport bilan shug'ullansa kerak.

questions.sentence: It is so difficult to have ________________ hair because you always need to make them straight.
questions.explanation: curly hair = jingalak soch.
questions.translation: Jingalak sochlarga ega bo'lish juda qiyin, chunki ularni doim to'g'rilash kerak bo'ladi.

questions.sentence: Son: Daddy, what is ________________? Dad: It’s facial hair between lips and nose, son.
questions.explanation: moustache = lab va burun o'rtasidagi tuklar (mo'ylov).
questions.translation: O'g'il: Dada, mo'ylov nima? Ota: Bu lab va burun o'rtasidagi soch, o'g'lim.

questions.sentence: My Uncle Sam has lost his hair and now he is completely ________________.
questions.explanation: completely bald = butunlay sochsiz / kal.
questions.translation: Sem tog'am sochlarini yo'qotdi va hozir butunlay kal.

questions.sentence: Andrew is so ________________. I don’t think he even weighs 50 kg!
questions.explanation: slim / thin = ozg'in.
questions.translation: Endryu shunchalik ozg'inki, u 50 kg ham chiqmasa kerak!
